```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

def plot_route_fuel_cost(df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    """
    Draws a line chart of monthly fuel cost in USD for each route.
    
    Parameters:
    df (pd.DataFrame): Must contain columns 'month', 'route', and 'fuel_cost_usd'.
    """
    if not all(col in df.columns for col in ['month', 'route', 'fuel_cost_usd']):
        raise ValueError("DataFrame must contain columns: 'month', 'route', 'fuel_cost_usd'")

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    
    # Group by route and plot each line
    for route_name, group in df.groupby('route'):
        plt.plot(group['month'], group['fuel_cost_usd'], label=route_name, marker='o')
    
    # Set labels with units in square brackets as per user preference
    plt.xlabel('Month')
    plt.ylabel('Fuel Cost [USD]')
    plt.title('Monthly Fuel Cost by Route')
    
    # Add legend
    plt.legend(title='Route')
    
    # Show grid for better readability
    plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
    
    # Tight layout to prevent label clipping
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    # Display the plot
    plt.show()
```
